import json,re,collections
from pathlib import Path

packet=json.loads(Path('packet.json').read_text())
items=packet['items']
assert len(items)==139
assert len({item['id'] for item in items})==139

def literal(value):
    return \"'\"+value.replace('\\\\','\\\\\\\\').replace(\"'\",\"\\\\'\")+\"'\"

pack_match='MATCH (d)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK|HAS_CR]-(p:CRPack)'
decision_match=\"MATCH (r:Resolution {resolutionScope: 'document_disposition'})-[:HAS_DISPOSITION|DISPOSITION_OF]-(dd:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(d)\"
meeting_match=\"MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {workingGroup: 'RAN4'})\"
expressions={
    'document':'d.tdocNumber',
    'final_document':'d.tdocNumber',
    'disposition':'dd.dispositionCode',
    'wg_meeting':'m.meetingNumber',
    'cr_pack':'p.crPackId',
    'tsg_meeting':'p.tsgMeeting',
    'clause':'s.sectionNumber',
}
rows=[]
shapes=collections.Counter()
family_counts=collections.Counter()

for item in items:
    question=item['question']
    fields=tuple(item['fields'])
    document_match=re.search(r'\\bR4-\\d+\\b',question)
    document=document_match.group() if document_match else None
    spec_match=re.search(r'\\bTS ([\\d.-]+)',question)
    spec=spec_match.group(1) if spec_match else None

    if fields==('cr_pack','tsg_meeting'):
        assert question.startswith('In which TSG RAN CR pack was change request ')
        clauses=[f'MATCH (d:Tdoc {{tdocNumber: {literal(document)}}})-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK|HAS_CR]-(p:CRPack)']
        family='cr_pack'

    elif fields==('final_document','disposition','cr_pack'):
        assert question.startswith('RAN4 recorded document ')
        clauses=[
            f'MATCH path = (start:Tdoc {{tdocNumber: {literal(document)}}})-[:REVISED_TO|IS_REVISION_OF*1..]-(d:Tdoc)',
            \"WHERE d <> start AND all(i IN range(0, length(path) - 1) WHERE (type(relationships(path)[i]) = 'REVISED_TO' AND startNode(relationships(path)[i]) = nodes(path)[i]) OR (type(relationships(path)[i]) = 'IS_REVISION_OF' AND endNode(relationships(path)[i]) = nodes(path)[i]))\",
            'WITH DISTINCT d',
            pack_match,
            decision_match,
            meeting_match,
        ]
        family='later_revisions'

    elif fields==('disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack','tsg_meeting','clause'):
        assert question.startswith('Trace change request ')
        assert re.findall(r'\\bTS ([\\d.-]+)',question)==[spec,spec]
        clauses=[
            f'MATCH (d:Tdoc {{tdocNumber: {literal(document)}}})-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK|HAS_CR]-(p:CRPack)',
            f'MATCH (d)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION|MODIFIED_BY_CR]-(s:Section {{specNumber: {literal(spec)}}})',
            decision_match,
            meeting_match,
        ]
        family='cr_decision_pack_clauses'

    elif fields==('document','disposition','wg_meeting'):
        assert question.startswith('TSG RAN CR pack ')
        pack=re.search(r'\\bRP-\\d+\\b',question).group()
        clauses=[
            f'MATCH (p:CRPack {{crPackId: {literal(pack)}}})-[:HAS_CR|BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]-(d:Tdoc)',
            decision_match,
            meeting_match,
        ]
        family='pack_cr_decisions'

    elif fields==('disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack','tsg_meeting'):
        assert question.startswith('Change request ')
        clauses=[
            f'MATCH (d:Tdoc {{tdocNumber: {literal(document)}}})-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK|HAS_CR]-(p:CRPack)',
            decision_match,
            meeting_match,
        ]
        family='cr_decision_pack'

    elif fields==('document','disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack'):
        assert question.startswith('Which Rel-')
        release=re.search(r'\\bRel-\\d+\\b',question).group()
        clause=re.search(r'\\bclause (\\S+) of TS ',question).group(1)
        clauses=[
            f'MATCH (d:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(:Release {{releaseName: {literal(release)}}})',
            f'MATCH (d)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION|MODIFIED_BY_CR]-(s:Section {{specNumber: {literal(spec)}, sectionNumber: {literal(clause)}}})',
            pack_match,
            decision_match,
            meeting_match,
        ]
        family='release_clause_cr_decisions'
    else:
        raise AssertionError((item['id'],'unrecognized question fields'))

    clauses.append('RETURN DISTINCT '+', '.join(expressions[field]+' AS '+field for field in fields))
    query='\\n'.join(clauses)
    returned=query.rsplit('RETURN DISTINCT ',1)[1]
    assert tuple(re.findall(r'\\bAS (\\w+)\\b',returned))==fields
    assert all(re.match(r'"'^(MATCH|WHERE|WITH|RETURN)'"\\b',line) for line in query.splitlines())
    without_literals=re.sub(r\"'(?:\\\\.|["'^'"'\\\\])*'\",\"'?'\",query)
    assert not re.search(r'\\b(?:CREATE|MERGE|SET|REMOVE|DELETE|DETACH|DROP|LOAD|CALL|UNWIND|UNION|OPTIONAL|FOREACH)\\b',without_literals,re.I)
    assert query.count('RETURN DISTINCT ')==1
    row={'id':item['id'],'cypher':query}
    assert json.loads(json.dumps(row))==row
    rows.append(row)
    shapes[without_literals]+=1
    family_counts[family]+=1

assert len(rows)==139
assert len(shapes)==6
assert [row['id'] for row in rows]==[item['id'] for item in items]
header=packet['task'].split('Stored value domains,')[0]
allowed_labels=set(re.findall(r'\\(:([A-Za-z]\\w*)',header))
allowed_relationships=set(re.findall(r'\\[:([A-Za-z]\\w*)\\]',header))
for row in rows:
    query=row['cypher']
    assert set(re.findall(r'\\([A-Za-z_]*:([A-Za-z]\\w*)',query))<=allowed_labels
    for relationship_pattern in re.findall(r'\\[:([A-Z_|]+)(?:\\*["'^'"\\]]*)?\\]',query):
        assert set(relationship_pattern.split('|'))<=allowed_relationships

serialized=''.join(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False)+'\\n' for row in rows)
assert len(serialized.splitlines())==139
Path('queries.jsonl').write_text(serialized,encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'queries_written':len(rows),'distinct_query_shapes':len(shapes),'family_counts':dict(family_counts),'static_validation':'passed; no queries executed','wording_exceptions':[]},ensure_ascii=False))
PY"
